_comment: VEP's four impact classes, in the order Ensembl defines them.
The order is convention, not recoverable from the strings:
variant_molecular_effects carries the class per row; this is

variant_impacts.name: HIGH
variant_impacts.description: Assumed to have a disruptive impact on the protein, likely causing loss of function.

variant_impacts.name: MODERATE
variant_impacts.description: A non-disruptive variant that might change protein effectiveness.

variant_impacts.name: LOW
variant_impacts.description: Assumed to be mostly harmless or unlikely to change protein behaviour.

variant_impacts.name: MODIFIER
variant_impacts.description: Usually non-coding or with no evidence of impact; ranked last.
